title: Lab 5 gateway log record
description: One JSON object per line in logs/gateway/gateway.jsonl, exactly one per request the gateway received -- including requests it blocked or failed on. lab5/schema.py is the executable version of this contract and is what the scorer runs.

ts.description: When the request arrived, ISO-8601 UTC ending in Z.

request_id.description: The client's X-Request-ID if it sent one, else one you generate and return. Propagated to the service.

client_ip.description: From X-Client-IP, which the load balancer (here: the load generator) sets and you may trust.

tenant.description: Null only if the request could not be authenticated.

key_id.description: The key_id from config/tenants.json. Never the key itself.

route.description: The request path, without query string.

status.description: The HTTP status the client received.

block_reason.description: Set if and only if outcome is blocked.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the request body exactly as received (empty body: SHA-256 of zero bytes).

response_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the response body exactly as sent to the client, after any redaction.

tokens_in.description: Billed input tokens, from the service's usage. 0 if nothing was forwarded.

reserved_usd.description: What you reserved against the tenant's budget before forwarding. 0 if not forwarded.

tool_calls.description: Tool names, in order, from the service's usage.

latency_ms.description: Time from arrival to the last byte of your response.

limits.description: What you granted the service for this request; null where it does not apply.
